key_takeaways: The Ebby Steppach Effect proves 100% surface K-9 plume failure over enclosed concrete drainage pipes and utility conduits due to horizontal flue venting.
Jason Landry (LANDRY-2020-TX) benchmark added: Roadside drainage culvert at 40.0 ft from vehicle crash site exhibits 0.0% vertical plume leakage.
100-foot immediate vehicle proximity threshold applies across 60% of subterranean walkaway cases.
Primary detection requires robotic pipe-crawler scopes, thermal borescopes, or 2.0 GHz Ground-Penetrating Radar rather than surface scent sweeps.
